jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3-5 years of experience building high-performance backend systems, distributed data pipelines, or data-intensive applications Practical experience with retrieval and search, including embeddings, vector search, lexical search (BM25/Lucene/OpenSearch), and reranking trade-offs Hands-on experience using AI coding agents in an AI-native development workflow (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and designing with agent-first primitives
